outcome: Doppler indices (umbilical artery systolic/diastolic ratio, pulsatility index, middle cerebral artery pulsatility index)
cohort: 100 pregnant women were divided into a fasting group (minimum 10 days of fasting) and a non-fasting group, with median age 27 years and BMI 25 kg/m2.
finding: Maternal fasting during Ramadan does not adversely affect Doppler indices, amniotic fluid index, non-stress test, and fetal condition, although the median pulsatility index was significantly higher in the non-fasted group.
